description: Refresh this account's local data from WhatsApp — pulls recent messages and refreshes the groups/contacts lists into the local store. Call it BEFORE reading (chats/groups/messages/contacts/search) when results look stale or empty (e.g. right after connecting, or an account that hasn't synced recently). Connects live, so it may take ~20–60s. Returns { messages_stored }.
name: whatsapp_sync
